syntaxOnlyGrammarClass: The host bundles grammars for seven languages: rust, typescript, javascript (syntaxClass code) and json, toml, markdown, yaml (syntaxClass data-document). Code grammars have the section 6.3 body spans and the published L2/L3 normalisation tables, so they bear clone body identity and the code-construct syntax relations. Data/document grammars are bundled and accounted - their files are grammar-only members bearing inventory evidence, never unsupported-file - but this kit publishes no tokenisation, literalKind mapping or normalisation law for them, so they mint no body identity and produce no code-construct fact. The syntax and clones cells above are qualified accordingly; nothing that was previously representable has been narrowed, and data-format syntax facts remain a bounded future capability that would need a published tokenisation law first.
